title: What are Generics?
overview: Generics allow developers to create reusable components, functions, and classes that work with different types while maintaining type safety.

title: Generic Functions
overview: Generic functions use type parameters to accept different types of arguments while preserving the relationship between input and output types.

example.title: Generic Function

title: Generic Arrays
overview: Generics can define the type of values stored inside arrays. This provides reusable array structures.

example.title: Generic Array
example.content:
let numbers: Array<number> = [1,2,3];

let names: Array<string> = ['A','B'];

title: Generic Interfaces
overview: Interfaces can use generics to create flexible structures that work with different data types.

title: Generic Constraints
overview: Generic constraints limit the types that can be used with a generic. They ensure that required properties or behaviors exist.

title: Generics in React Native
overview: Generics are useful in React Native for creating reusable components, API response types, hooks, and utility functions.

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned how generics create reusable and type-safe code using generic functions, arrays, interfaces, constraints, and React Native examples.
